title: Weekly digest 2026-W44: 86 items this week
summary: Index of 86 items: Kouka 18, Lacia 10, Saturnus 12, Methode 34, Snowdrop 12.
summary_en: Weekly index of 86 items, sorted by column. Titles are listed as published; Chinese items carry their own English summaries in their cards.
body:
